fields.text_0011: Hi, I'm Valerie. I help women leverage the power of  authenticity and self-care so they can thrive, personally and professionally. It's what I call Coming True™.
fields.text_0013: "Come home to who you are so you can live the life you have imagined."
fields.text_0014: I believe in the extraordinary power of women. For over two decades, I've been helping women transform their beliefs, mindsets, and habits to create happier, healthier, more fulfilled lives while avoiding burnout.
fields.text_0015: My mission is to empower women in business to embrace authenticity and self-love so they thrive in their personal and professional lives.
fields.text_0016: The journey toward authenticity is liberating – like shedding a skin that never fit well, or removing layers of heavy, life-long armor.
fields.text_0017: Imagine a life where you have the courage to speak your truth, express your needs, and pursue your true passions. A world where authenticity and mindfulness become effortless, and self-care is non-negotiable. Picture this life —
